In this benchmark pack, the presentation guidance is written to support pinned presets, repeated trials, and presentation-ready artifacts.

title: Split latency into stages for presentation
body: Keep stage timings for presentation and reproducibility instead of collapsing everything into one opaque total. That decomposition is what turns the project into a usable benchmark rather than a stopwatch. title: Preserve fairness for presentation
body: Use fixed presets so presentation and reproducibility is compared under the same conditions every time. Pinned presets are one of the easiest ways to make a benchmark feel credible. title: Use real data carefully for presentation

title: Keep a synthetic control for presentation
